en: Sura 70: Al-Ma'arij
ja: 第70章 階段章

p.src: 70:1  A challenger asked for a punishment bound to come[1]

en: A challenger asked for a punishment bound to come[1]
ja: 請う者が、（自分と自分の民に、復活の日*に）起こるべき懲罰（が下されること）を請うた。[1]
u.src: 70:1  A challenger asked for a punishment bound to come[1]

en: [1] In the Hereafter. The pagans of Makkah had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) in ridicule by asking Allah to bring upon them His punishment. See 8:32.
ja: [1]　これは、懲罰を早く下してみよ、という不信仰者*の挑発的な言葉とされる（アル＝バガウィー５：1５1参照）。家畜章５７－５８、戦利品*章３2、ユーヌス*章５０、フード*章８、雷鳴章６、夜の旅章９2、巡礼*章４７、蜘蛛章５３、サード章1６、相談章1８も参照。

p.src: 70:2  upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

en: upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,
ja: 不信仰者*たちには、それを防いでくれる者など、いない。
u.src: 70:2  upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

p.src: 70:3  from Allah, Lord of the pathways of ascent,

en: from Allah, Lord of the pathways of ascent,
ja: 階段の主[1]であられるアッラー*から（、それを防いでくれる者など）。
u.src: 70:3  from Allah, Lord of the pathways of ascent,

ja: [1]　天使*が天へと昇って行く「『階段』の主」のほかにも、「高さの極みと、位階、徳、恩恵を備えたお方」「偉大さと至高性の主」といった解釈がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1９：2８1参照）。

p.src: 70:4  by which the angels and the Spirit[2] will ascend to Him on a Day[3] the length of which is fifty thousand years.

en: by which the angels and the Spirit[2] will ascend to Him on a Day[3] the length of which is fifty thousand years.
ja: 天使*たちと魂[1]は、その長さが五万年もの日、かれの御許へと昇っていく[2]。
u.src: 70:4  by which the angels and the Spirit[2] will ascend to Him on a Day[3] the length of which is fifty thousand years.

en:
[2] i.e., the angel Gabriel.
 [3] The Day of Judgment will be an extremely long day.
ja: [1]　この「魂」には、「ジブリール*」「人間の魂」といった解釈がある（イブン・カスィール８：22０参照）。 [2]　これは一説に「復活の日*」の事。また一説には「地上からアッラー*の御座（高壁章５４とその訳注も参照）までの階段を、彼ら以外であれば五万年かかるところを、一日で昇る」事を指す（イブン・ジャウズィー８：３５９－３６０参照）。

p.src: 70:5  So be patient [O Prophet] with beautiful patience.

en: So be patient [O Prophet] with beautiful patience.
ja: ならば（使徒*よ、彼らの嘲笑と挑発に）、よき忍耐[1]で忍耐*せよ。
u.src: 70:5  So be patient [O Prophet] with beautiful patience.

ja: [1]　「よき忍耐*」については、ユースフ*章1８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:6  Indeed, they see this [punishment] far off,

en: Indeed, they see this [punishment] far off,
ja: 本当に彼ら（不信仰者*）は、それ（懲罰）があり得ないと思っている。
u.src: 70:6  Indeed, they see this [punishment] far off,

p.src: 70:7  but We see it to be close at hand.

en: but We see it to be close at hand.
ja: そしてわれら*は、それが近い（日に、確実に到来する）ものと見る。
u.src: 70:7  but We see it to be close at hand.

p.src: 70:8  On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass[4]

en: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass[4]
ja: 天が、溶けた鉛のようになる日。
u.src: 70:8  On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass[4]

en: [4] Or "murky oil."

p.src: 70:9  and the mountains will be like dyed wool[5],

en: and the mountains will be like dyed wool[5],
ja: また山々が、（解されて散り散りになった、）染められた羊毛のようになる日。[1]
u.src: 70:9  and the mountains will be like dyed wool[5],

en: [5] While disintegrating.
ja: [1]　復活の日*の天変地異の様子については、洞窟章４７、ター・ハー章1０５－1０７、蟻章８８、山章９－1０、出来事章５－６、衣を纏（まと）う者章1４、真実章1４－1６、消息章2０、巻き込む章３、衝撃章４－５も参照。

p.src: 70:10  and no close friend will ask about another,

en: and no close friend will ask about another,
ja: 近しい者が、近いしい者について尋ねることもない。[1]
u.src: 70:10  and no close friend will ask about another,

ja: [1]　この解釈には、「人はその日、近しい者からの援助を請うことはない。なぜなら彼が何も出来ないことを、知っているからである」「誰しもが自分のことで頭が一杯なため、他人のことを尋ねる余裕もない」といった説がある（イブン・ジュザイ2：４８６参照）。

p.src: 70:11  even though they will see one another. The wicked will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by offering his children,

en: even though they will see one another. The wicked will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by offering his children,
ja: 彼らには、彼ら[1]が見える。（不信仰だった）罪悪者は、自分の子供たちで、その日の懲罰を償えば、と望む。
u.src: 70:11  even though they will see one another. The wicked will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by offering his children,

ja: [1]　二つの「彼ら」については、「いずれも、近しい者たち」「信仰者たちが、地獄にいる不信仰者たちを見せられる」「いずれも不信仰者*だが、前者は追従者たち、後者は指導者たち」「前者は天使*たち、後者は人々」といった説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1８：2８５－2８６参照）。

p.src: 70:12  and his wife and his brother,

en: and his wife and his brother,
ja: また自分の配偶者、兄弟、
u.src: 70:12  and his wife and his brother,

p.src: 70:13  and his kindred who stood by him,

en: and his kindred who stood by him,
ja: 自分を匿ってくれる近親、
u.src: 70:13  and his kindred who stood by him,

p.src: 70:14  and everyone on earth, just to save himself.

en: and everyone on earth, just to save himself.
ja: そして地上の全ての者（によって自らの懲罰を償うこと）で、（その代償が）自分を救ってくれることを（望む）。
u.src: 70:14  and everyone on earth, just to save himself.

p.src: 70:15  By no means![6] It is a raging Flame,

en: By no means![6] It is a raging Flame,
ja: 断じて（、そんなことは役に立た）ない！実にそれ（地獄）は燃え盛るもの。
u.src: 70:15  By no means![6] It is a raging Flame,

en: [6] An emphatic denial, meaning "It will never be."

p.src: 70:16  that will strip off the scalps[7].

en: that will strip off the scalps[7].
ja: （それは、）身体の各部[1]をもぎ取る。
u.src: 70:16  that will strip off the scalps[7].

en: [7] Referring to the skin of the head or of the body extremities, which will be burned away by severe heat and flames.
ja: [1]　「身体の各部」の解釈には、ほかにも「頭皮」「骨以外の肉」「顔の重要な部分」といった諸説がある（アル＝バガウィー５：1５３参照）。

p.src: 70:17  It will call everyone who turned their backs and disobeyed,

en: It will call everyone who turned their backs and disobeyed,
ja: それは、招くのである。（現世での真理に）背を向け、（アッラー*とその使徒*への服従から）背き去り、
u.src: 70:17  It will call everyone who turned their backs and disobeyed,

p.src: 70:18  and amassed and hoarded wealth.

en: and amassed and hoarded wealth.
ja: （財産を）かき集めては、（そこにおけるアッラー*への義務も果たすことなく、）貯めこんだ者を。
u.src: 70:18  and amassed and hoarded wealth.

p.src: 70:19  Indeed, man was created impatient:

en: Indeed, man was created impatient:
ja: 本当に人間は、せっかちに創られた。
u.src: 70:19  Indeed, man was created impatient:

p.src: 70:20  when evil befalls him, he bewails,

en: when evil befalls him, he bewails,
ja: 悪が自分に降りかかれば、ひどく取り乱し、
u.src: 70:20  when evil befalls him, he bewails,

p.src: 70:21  but when good fortune comes his way, he becomes tight-fisted –

en: but when good fortune comes his way, he becomes tight-fisted –
ja: 善が自分に降りかかれば、強欲になる。
u.src: 70:21  but when good fortune comes his way, he becomes tight-fisted –

p.src: 70:22  except those who pray,

en: except those who pray,
ja: 但し、礼拝する者たちは別だが。[1]
u.src: 70:22  except those who pray,

ja: [1]　彼らは礼拝の遵守ゆえ、現世においては慎ましい人間となった者たちである。彼らは、現世での悪い出来事に取り乱すこともなく、善い物事に対して強欲になることもない（イブン・ジュザイ2：４８６ー４８７参照）。

p.src: 70:23  who are steadfast in their prayers;

en: who are steadfast in their prayers;
ja: （彼らは、）自らの礼拝を常々（守りつつ、）行う者たち。
u.src: 70:23  who are steadfast in their prayers;

p.src: 70:24  and who give a due share[8] of their wealth

en: and who give a due share[8] of their wealth
ja: また、自らの財産の内に、（施しのための）一定の権利[1]がある者たち、
u.src: 70:24  and who give a due share[8] of their wealth

en: [8] i.e., obligatory charity; zakah.
ja: [1]　この「権利」については、撒き散らすもの章1９の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:25  to the beggar and the dispossessed;

en: to the beggar and the dispossessed;
ja: （人々に施しを）要求する者にも、（それを）禁じられた者[1]に対しても。
u.src: 70:25  to the beggar and the dispossessed;

ja: [1]　「禁じられた者」については、撒き散らすもの章1９の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:26  and who firmly believe in the Day of Judgment;

en: and who firmly believe in the Day of Judgment;
ja: また、報いの日*を信じ（、正しい行い*によってそれに備える）る者たち。
u.src: 70:26  and who firmly believe in the Day of Judgment;

p.src: 70:27  and those who fear the punishment of their Lord –

en: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord –
ja: また、自らの主*の懲罰に、怯える者たち。
u.src: 70:27  and those who fear the punishment of their Lord –

p.src: 70:28  for none can feel secure from their Lord’s punishment –

en: for none can feel secure from their Lord’s punishment –
ja: ——本当に彼らの主*の懲罰は、（誰も）安心していられるものではないのだから——。
u.src: 70:28  for none can feel secure from their Lord’s punishment –

p.src: 70:29  and those who guard their private parts[9],

en: and those who guard their private parts[9],
ja: また、自らの陰部を（禁じられた物事[1]から）守る者たち。
u.src: 70:29  and those who guard their private parts[9],

en: [9] i.e., their chastity and honor from immoralities.
ja: [1]　この「禁じられた物事」については、御光章３０の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:30  except from their wives or bondwomen[10] whom they own, for then they are not to be blamed.

en: except from their wives or bondwomen[10] whom they own, for then they are not to be blamed.
ja: 但し、自分の妻たち、あるいは自分の右手が所有するもの（奴隷*女性）は別で、本当に彼ら（合法な物事だけを行う者たち）は咎められ者などではない。
u.src: 70:30  except from their wives or bondwomen[10] whom they own, for then they are not to be blamed.

en: [10] i.e., female slaves or slave-girls.

p.src: 70:31  But whoever seeks beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

en: But whoever seeks beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.
ja: 誰であろうとそれ以上を欲する者、それらの者たちこそは（アッラー*の法の）違反者なのだ。
u.src: 70:31  But whoever seeks beyond that, it is they who are the transgressors.

p.src: 70:32  and those who fulfill their trusts and pledges;

en: and those who fulfill their trusts and pledges;
ja: また、自らの信託と契約を厳守する[1]者たち。
u.src: 70:32  and those who fulfill their trusts and pledges;

ja: [1]　同様のアーヤ*である、信仰者たち章８の訳注も参照。

p.src: 70:33  and who are upright in their testimonies;

en: and who are upright in their testimonies;
ja: また自らの証言を（改変も隠蔽もなく）遂行する者たち。
u.src: 70:33  and who are upright in their testimonies;

p.src: 70:34  and who take due care of their prayers;

en: and who take due care of their prayers;
ja: また、自分たちの礼拝を固守する者たち。
u.src: 70:34  and who take due care of their prayers;

p.src: 70:35  they will be honored in gardens[11].

en: they will be honored in gardens[11].
ja: それらの者たちは天国で、厚遇される者たちである。
u.src: 70:35  they will be honored in gardens[11].

en: [11] Of Paradise.

p.src: 70:36  What is the matter with the disbelievers that they are rushing towards you [O Prophet][12],

en: What is the matter with the disbelievers that they are rushing towards you [O Prophet][12],
ja: （使徒*よ、）不信仰に陥った者*たちが、あなたに、向かってあたふたとやって来るのは、どうしたことか？[1]
u.src: 70:36  What is the matter with the disbelievers that they are rushing towards you [O Prophet][12],

en: [12] i.e., rushing to deny you.
ja: [1]　一説にこのアーヤ*は、預言者*の言葉を聞き、嘲笑（ちょうしょう）し、噓呼ばわりするため、彼のもとに集まって来た不信仰者*たちの集団に関して下った（アル＝バガウィー５：1５４参照）。

p.src: 70:37  from the right and from the left, in crowds[13]?

en: from the right and from the left, in crowds[13]?
ja: 右から左から、三々五々に？
u.src: 70:37  from the right and from the left, in crowds[13]?

en: [13] Some pagans of Makkah gathered around the Prophet (ﷺ) mocking and opposing him, claiming that if there is in fact a Hereafter, they would enter Paradise before the believers.

p.src: 70:38  Does everyone of them aspire to enter a garden of bliss?

en: Does everyone of them aspire to enter a garden of bliss?
ja: 一体、彼ら（不信仰者*たち）の内のいずれの者も、安寧の楽園に入られることを所望しているというのか？[1]
u.src: 70:38  Does everyone of them aspire to enter a garden of bliss?

ja: [1]　彼らは、「彼ら（ムスリム*たち）が天国に入るのであれば、必ずや私たちこそが、彼らよりも先にそこに入るであろう。そして彼らがそこから何か授かるのなら、必ずや私たちこそが、それより多くのものを授かるだろう」などと言ったものだった（アル＝クルトゥビー1８：2９４参照）。

p.src: 70:39  By no means! We have created them from what they know[14].

en: By no means! We have created them from what they know[14].
ja: 断じて（、そんなことは絶対にあり得）ない！本当にわれら*は彼らが知っているもの[1]から、彼らを創ったのだから。
u.src: 70:39  By no means! We have created them from what they know[14].

en: [14] i.e., from a disdained fluid.
ja: [1]　彼ら以外の者たちと同じ、しがない一滴の精液から創られたのだから、天国に入るに値するほど高貴な存在だなどと考えるのではない、ということ（ムヤッサル５６９頁参照）。

p.src: 70:40  I swear by the Lord of the sunrises and sunsets[15] that We are surely Capable

en: I swear by the Lord of the sunrises and sunsets[15] that We are surely Capable
ja: われはまさに、いくつもの東と、いくつもの西[1]において誓う[2]。本当にわれら*はまさしく、可能な者なのである、
u.src: 70:40  I swear by the Lord of the sunrises and sunsets[15] that We are surely Capable

en: [15] i.e., Allah is the One Who determines the daily points of sunrise and sunset according to each season by the rotation of the earth around its axis.
ja: [1]　ここでの「いくつもの束」と「いくつもの西」は、同年において毎日異なる、太陽の昇る地点と沈む地点のこととされる（アル＝バガウィー４：2６参照）。 [2]　この誓いについては、整列者章1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:41  to replace them with others better than them, and none can escape Our decree.

en: to replace them with others better than them, and none can escape Our decree.
ja: 彼らよりも（アッラー*に服従する）善い者たちを、（彼らの）代わりとすることが。そしてわれらは、出し抜かれる者などではない。
u.src: 70:41  to replace them with others better than them, and none can escape Our decree.

p.src: 70:42  So leave them to engage in their falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised;

en: So leave them to engage in their falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised;
ja: ならば（使徒*よ）、彼らを放っておけ。彼らは、自分たちが（懲罰[1]を）約束されている日に遭遇するまで、（虚妄の中に）のめり込み、（宗教において）戯れるであろう。
u.src: 70:42  So leave them to engage in their falsehood and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised;

ja: [1]　この「懲罰」については、金の装飾章８３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:43  the Day when they will rush out of their graves as if they are racing towards an idol[16],

en: the Day when they will rush out of their graves as if they are racing towards an idol[16],
ja: まるで（アッラー*を差しおいて崇めるために）立てられたもの[1]へと急ぐように、彼らが墓場から慌てて出て来る日に（遭遇するまで）。
u.src: 70:43  the Day when they will rush out of their graves as if they are racing towards an idol[16],

en: [16] i.e., just as they used to race towards a newly appointed idol, to be among the first of its worshipers.
ja: [1]　この「立てられたもの」については、食卓章３の訳注を参照。

p.src: 70:44  with their eyes downcast and overwhelmed with disgrace. That is the Day that they were promised.

en: with their eyes downcast and overwhelmed with disgrace. That is the Day that they were promised.
ja: 怖気づいた目をし、屈辱が彼らを覆う。それが（現世で）、彼らに約束されていた日なのである。
u.src: 70:44  with their eyes downcast and overwhelmed with disgrace. That is the Day that they were promised.
